items.html: And afterwards there was the second Ibur, of the Mochin of the interiority, and this was in the aspect of seven months alone. The matter is that this Ibur is very concealed and exalted, for it is in the aspect of the seven lower Sefirot of Atik, which are clothed within the seven Tikunim of the Galgalta of the head of AA, as explained by us; and corresponding to them this Ibur was of seven months.
